desk_read: Energy markets saw severe selling yesterday as WTI Crude Oil dropped -8.29% on heavy volume of 1.5x its 20-day average alongside a +5.2k contracts total open interest build, driving new shorts into backwardation while Brent NYMEX shed -8.67% on heavy volume of 1.4x its 20-day average with a -202 contracts open interest reduction indicating long liquidation. Precious metals caught strong upside participation led by Gold rallying +3.37% on volume at 1.1x its 20-day average alongside a +3.3k contracts open interest increase signaling new longs in contango, and Silver jumping +5.08% on volume of 1.2x its 20-day average with a +169 contracts open interest gain. Equity index futures reflected mixed positioning dynamics, as S&P 500 gained +1.63% with a +11.1k contracts open interest addition pointing to new longs, contrasting with Nasdaq 100 rising +0.92% on a -3.5k contracts open interest drop pointing to short covering.
oil_read: WTI fell -8.29% with total open interest across all months up +5.2k contracts (+0.4%), on volume 1.5x its 20-day average indicating new shorts, alongside a backwardated curve where the CLZ26-CLK27 spread was +6.24 $/bbl. Brent dropped -8.67% with total open interest across all months down -202 contracts (-0.2%), on volume 1.4x its 20-day average signaling long liquidation, within a backwardated structure showing the BZZ26-BZK27 spread at +31.61 $/bbl.
bias_read: WTI Crude Oil shows a mildly bearish bias driven by fresh positions and high conviction volume, which supports downside momentum despite backwardation. Brent sits at neutral due to long liquidation on high conviction volume, warning of potential exhaustion in the current structure. Gold and Silver both display a mildly bullish bias through fresh positions, supporting upward continuation. Meanwhile, Copper registers a mildly bullish bias from short covering on high conviction volume, carrying a risk of a squeeze. Overall, the flow reveals selective fresh positioning alongside corrective closures, pointing to a cautious short term environment without broad directional conviction.
